strategy.thesis: Sector-agnostic 'Day Zero' investor that backs founders pre-idea, helps with co-founder matching and company formation during a six-week residency, then invests with conviction and follows on through later stages.

summary.en: Antler is a global early-stage VC and accelerator founded in 2017 and headquartered in Singapore, with a dedicated Southeast Asia fund (US$72M SEA Fund II, 2024). Its six-week residency does co-founder matching and company building, then invests $150,000 for 10% equity plus a $50,000 uncapped SAFE, with follow-on capital available. Over 1,500 portfolio companies globally.
